任务在设备上运行。关闭桌面窗口后，设备上的任务会继续。: Tasks run on your device and continue after you close this window.
仅本次使用，进入控制台: Continue to console for this session
使用 SSH 私钥文件: Use an SSH private key file
请选择不超过 32 KB 的 SSH 私钥文件。: Select an SSH private key file no larger than 32 KB.
仅用于本次 SSH 登录，不保存在连接资料中。: Used for this SSH session only; not saved in the connection profile.
用于建立加密隧道。之后还需登录设备账户。: Used to establish the encrypted tunnel. You will then sign in to the device account.
可以自动查找本机服务，也可以添加局域网设备的 HTTPS 或 SSH 地址。: Discover a local service or add a LAN device using its HTTPS or SSH address.
本机可用 HTTP，局域网设备使用 HTTPS 或 SSH。连接资料只保存在这台: Local services can use HTTP; LAN devices use HTTPS or SSH. Connection profiles stay on this computer.
填写已安装服务的设备地址。连接成功后，再登录设备账户。: Enter the address of a device with the service installed, then connect and sign in.
设备使用私有 CA / 自签名证书: Device uses a private CA / self-signed certificate
证书文件过大。: The certificate file is too large.
从设备本地、已可信控制台或已核验 SSH 获取，不要上传任何私钥。: Obtain it locally from the device, a trusted console or verified SSH. Never upload a private key.
仅连接这台电脑上的服务，地址只允许 127.0.0.1 或 ::1。HTTP 不: Connects only to 127.0.0.1 or ::1 on this computer. HTTP is unencrypted, but traffic stays on this computer. Sign-in is still required.
请在设备本地屏幕或已可信入口核对完整指纹。局域网发现结果和同一条未验证网络连接不: Verify the full fingerprint on the device or through a trusted connection. LAN discovery or the same unverified connection cannot establish its identity.
我已通过可信入口核对设备指纹: I verified the device fingerprint through a trusted source
自动检查本机程序、本地服务和同一网络中的设备。查找时不会发送登录信息。: Checks local installations, services and devices on your network. Discovery sends no sign-in information.
正在查找设备广播，约 4 秒…: Looking for device announcements, about 4 seconds…
已停止查找，可以重新扫描或手工填写地址。: Discovery stopped. Scan again or enter an address manually.
暂未找到设备。请确认设备已开机、电脑与设备在同一局域网，再点击“扫描局域网”；也: No devices found. Check that the device is on and connected to the same LAN, then scan again or enter its address.
当前没有可扫描的有线或 Wi-Fi 内网连接，请手工填写地址。: No wired or Wi-Fi LAN is available to scan. Enter the address manually.
已完成有限范围查找。较大网段或其他 VLAN 的设备请手工添加。: The bounded scan is complete. Add devices on larger subnets or other VLANs manually.
已发现本机运行中的服务，可通过本机 HTTP 连接。: A running local service was found. Connect using local HTTP.
发现本机程序，但未检测到运行中的服务。请先启动服务；如使用自定义端口，可手工添加: A local installation was found, but no running service. Start it first, or enter its address if it uses a custom port.
未检测到本机程序或运行中的服务。自定义安装位置或端口可能无法自动识别，可手工填写: No local installation or service detected. Custom paths or ports may require entering the local address manually.
本机 HTTP 只连接电脑内部地址，仍需登录。其他设备需验证证书或 SSH 主机: Local HTTP stays on this computer and still requires sign-in. Other devices require certificate or SSH fingerprint verification.
已填入保存的登录信息，点击登录即可。: Saved sign-in details filled in. Click Sign in to continue.
修改登录信息后，可保存并替换原有记录。: You can save updated sign-in details to replace the existing record.
不勾选时仅当前会话使用。设备账户权限仍由设备管理。: Leave unchecked to use only for this session. Account permissions are managed by the device.
直接查看资产、转账或进行 Bancor 交易，无需登录设备。: View assets, transfer or trade on Bancor without signing in to a device.
私钥已在本机加密保存: The private key is encrypted on this computer
生成密钥对或从加密备份恢复，之后可独立使用资产和交易页面。: Generate a key pair or restore an encrypted backup to use assets and trading independently.
重新检查已保存节点，优先连接同一账本内响应快的可用节点: Check saved nodes and prefer a responsive available node on the same ledger
自动检查已保存节点，优先连接响应快的可用节点。也可以手动选择。: Saved nodes are checked automatically to prefer responsive available nodes. You can also choose manually.
私钥在这台电脑加密保存。查看资产无需解锁；每笔交易须输入密码确认。: Private keys are encrypted on this computer. Viewing assets needs no unlock; each transaction requires your password.
解锁后可创建、备份或恢复账号。查看资产不需要解锁。: Unlock to create, back up or restore accounts. Viewing assets needs no unlock.
设置至少 12 个字符的密码。密码不会发送到设备或资产服务。: Use at least 12 characters. The password is never sent to a device or asset service.
请核对以下实际签名内容。确认后会提交到所示节点。: Review the exact details to be signed. Confirmation submits them to the node shown below.
操作已确认完成。返回资产页面可刷新余额。: Operation completed. Return to assets to refresh balances.
操作已提交，结果待核实。请返回资产页面核实结果。: Operation submitted; the result is unconfirmed. Return to assets to check it.
本次操作未执行成功，请返回资产页面查看结果。: The operation did not succeed. Return to assets to view the result.
密码验证暂时受限，请在: Password verification is temporarily limited. Retry in
账户已生成并安全保存。请立即完成加密备份。: Account generated and securely saved. Create an encrypted backup now.
新建密钥对并安全保存: Generate and securely save key pair
两次备份密码不一致。: The backup passwords do not match.
加密备份已保存，并已读回验证。请另存到安全位置，记住备份密码。: Encrypted backup saved and verified by reading it back. Keep another copy in a safe place and remember its password.
导出前需再次验证密钥库密码，完成后自动锁定。备份密码用于换电脑恢复，请妥善保管。: Enter the vault password again to export; the vault locks afterward. Keep the backup password safe for recovery on another computer.
账号已恢复，公钥校验通过。: Account restored and public key verified.
解锁后最多保留 5 分钟，操作不会延长时限；关闭安全窗口、离开应用或系统锁屏会提: Unlock lasts at most 5 minutes and activity does not extend it. Closing the security window, leaving the app or locking the system locks it sooner. Losing the backup and password may prevent recovery. Accounts are independent of hardware binding and reward settings.
有操作需要核实结果: An operation needs a result check
先查询原操作结果，确认后再进行下一笔交易。: Check the original operation result before starting another transaction.
本机 HTTP 只允许 http://127.0.0.1:端口 或 http:/: Local HTTP allows only http://127.0.0.1:port or http://[::1]:port, without a path. Use HTTPS or SSH for LAN addresses.
未能连接本机服务。请先启动本机服务，并检查本机地址与端口。: Cannot connect to the local service. Start it and check its address and port.
上一次查找正在结束，请稍后重试。: The previous scan is ending. Try again shortly.
请输入 HTTPS 地址（只填写域名或 IP 和端口，不包含路径）。: Enter an HTTPS origin using a domain or IP and port, without a path.
地址格式不正确，请检查设备地址与端口。: Invalid address. Check the device address and port.
证书指纹不匹配。请从设备本地或已可信控制台重新核对完整指纹。: Certificate fingerprint mismatch. Verify the full fingerprint on the device or through a trusted console.
请选择公开 CA 证书，并填写从可信入口取得的 SHA-256 指纹。: Select a public CA certificate and enter its SHA-256 fingerprint from a trusted source.
这里只接受公开证书，不能导入任何私钥。: Only public certificates are accepted here. Do not import a private key.
请选择一个公开 CA 证书文件。: Select one public CA certificate file.
安全连接未建立。请检查设备在线状态、地址与端口，以及证书的主机名、有效期和信任来: Secure connection failed. Check the device, address, port and certificate hostname, validity and trust source.
连接超时。请确认设备已启动，且电脑能够访问设备所在网络。: Connection timed out. Check that the device is on and its network is reachable.
设备返回了地址跳转。为保护凭据，请核对并手工添加正确的 HTTPS 入口。: The device returned a redirect. Verify and manually add the correct HTTPS origin to protect your credentials.
SSH 主机身份与已核对的指纹不同，连接已停止。请从设备端核验身份。: SSH host identity differs from the verified fingerprint. Connection stopped; verify identity on the device.
SSH 连接未建立。请检查地址、端口、主机指纹以及 SSH 服务。: SSH connection failed. Check the address, port, host fingerprint and SSH service.
SSH 登录失败。请检查用户名、密码或私钥是否有权登录这台设备。: SSH sign-in failed. Check the username, password or key and its access to this device.
无法读取 SSH 私钥。请选择正确的私钥文件，并检查私钥口令。: Cannot read the SSH private key. Check the key file and passphrase.
打开的媒体预览过多，请关闭一些预览后再试。: Too many media previews are open. Close some and try again.
无法建立本机媒体通道，请重新启动客户端。: Cannot create the local media channel. Restart the client.
已打开 8 个应用窗口，请关闭一些窗口后再打开。: Eight app windows are already open. Close some before opening another.
请检查 SSH 地址、端口、用户名与完整 SHA256 主机指纹。: Check the SSH address, port, username and full SHA256 host fingerprint.
SSH 已连接，但无法访问设备上的 WEBD。请检查 WEBD 端口与 SSH: SSH connected, but the device WEBD is unreachable. Check its port and SSH forwarding permissions.
登录未通过。请检查设备账户、密码或用户 Key，以及该账户是否已被停用。: Sign-in failed. Check the account, password or user key and whether the account is disabled.
设备已响应，但缺少登录安全令牌。请重新连接；如果仍失败，请检查客户端与设备版本。: The device responded without a sign-in security token. Reconnect; if it persists, check client and device versions.
设备返回的登录安全令牌格式不匹配。请更新客户端后重新连接。: The sign-in security token format does not match. Update the client and reconnect.
登录尝试过多，请稍后再试。: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
系统凭据库不可用。可输入凭据，仅在当前会话登录。: System credential store unavailable. Enter credentials to sign in for this session only.
保存的登录信息不可用，请重新输入用户名和密码或用户 Key。: Saved sign-in details are unavailable. Enter the username and password or user key again.
系统凭据库已锁定或拒绝保存。本次登录仍可使用；解锁后可重新选择保存。: The credential store is locked or refused to save. This session still works; unlock the store to save later.
连接已变更，请回到设备列表重新连接。: The connection changed. Return to the device list and reconnect.
未找到可用的网页管理服务，请核对 HTTPS 入口或 WEBD 端口。: No web console service found. Check the HTTPS origin or WEBD port.
设备暂未响应。写操作可能已经提交，请回到原设备查询结果，不要重复提交。: The device has not responded. A write may already be submitted; check the original device before retrying.
无法写入文件。请检查磁盘剩余空间与保存位置权限。: Cannot write the file. Check free disk space and destination permissions.
暂时没有找到同一账本内可用的资产节点。请检查网络后重新优选，或手动选择节点。: No available asset node was found on the same ledger. Check your network and optimize again, or choose a node manually.
可用节点属于不同账本，请先手动选择要使用的节点。: Available nodes belong to different ledgers. Choose a node manually first.
无法建立资产节点的安全连接。请检查地址、网络和证书，或选择其他节点。: Cannot establish a secure asset node connection. Check the address, network and certificate or choose another node.
资产节点返回了重定向。请使用节点提供的直接 HTTPS 地址。: The asset node returned a redirect. Use its direct HTTPS address.
本机资产节点配置无法读取。请保留原文件后检查配置。: Cannot read local asset node settings. Preserve the original file and check the settings.
请选择并连接一个资产节点。: Select and connect to an asset node.
最多保存 32 个资产节点。: You can save up to 32 asset nodes.
该设备尚未支持桌面本地账户。账户已安全保存在本机，余额、交易和转账需等待后端升级: This device does not yet support desktop local accounts. Your account is safely stored locally; balances, trading and transfers require a backend update.
该设备目前只允许硬件绑定账户，尚未开放独立资产账户。: This device currently permits only hardware-bound accounts, not independent asset accounts.
密钥库已锁定。请打开“管理本地账号”解锁。: The vault is locked. Open Manage local accounts to unlock it.
请先在管理窗口完成加密备份，再使用这个账号。: Create an encrypted backup in account management before using this account.
密码不正确，或加密数据已损坏。请检查密码或使用加密备份恢复。: Incorrect password or damaged encrypted data. Check the password or restore an encrypted backup.
系统凭据库不可用或已锁定。请解锁系统凭据库后重试；私钥不会改存为明文。: The system credential store is unavailable or locked. Unlock it and retry; private keys will not be stored as plaintext.
密码至少需要 12 个字符，最多 1024 字节。: Use at least 12 characters and no more than 1024 bytes.
该账户已经保存在本机，无需重复恢复。: This account is already saved on this computer.
密码尝试过于频繁，请等待倒计时结束后重试。: Too many password attempts. Wait for the countdown before trying again.
服务端签名内容不符合安全合同，本次操作已停止。: The server signing payload failed safety validation. The operation was stopped.
服务端返回的账户、金额、费用或有效期与本次操作不一致，未签名。: The returned account, amount, fee or expiry does not match this operation. Nothing was signed.
服务端返回的数据无法验证。请刷新或联系服务端维护者。: The server response could not be verified. Refresh or contact the service maintainer.
资产节点未提供安全连接，已停止本次操作。: The asset node did not provide a secure connection. The operation was stopped.
资产节点或账本已经变化，请回到原节点核实交易结果。: The asset node or ledger changed. Check the transaction result on the original node.
已有一笔操作等待确认，请先到安全窗口处理。: An operation is awaiting confirmation. Handle it in the security window first.
本次确认已失效，请重新发起操作。: This confirmation is no longer valid. Start the operation again.
本次签名请求已过期，请重新获取。: The signing request expired. Request a new one.
暂时无法确认结果。请使用“核实结果”，不要重复提交。: The result is unconfirmed. Use Check result; do not resubmit.
资产服务请求过于频繁，结果尚未确认。请稍后使用“核实结果”，不要重复提交。: The asset service is rate limiting requests. Use Check result later; do not resubmit.
资产节点或登录上下文已变化。请恢复原节点并重新登录，再核实结果，不要重复提交。: The node or sign-in context changed. Restore the original node and sign in again to check the result; do not resubmit.
资产服务请求过于频繁，请稍后再试。: The asset service is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
市场价格或费用已变化，请重新获取报价并确认。: The market price or fee changed. Request and confirm a new quote.
收款账户不能与付款账户相同。: The recipient must differ from the sender.
金额低于当前市场可交易的最小额度。: The amount is below the current market minimum.
市场暂时无法成交，请稍后刷新报价再试。: Trading is unavailable. Refresh the quote and try again later.
此资产账户已被冻结，暂时无法操作。: This asset account is frozen and cannot be used right now.
系统储备和手续费账户不接受普通转账，请核对收款地址。: System reserve and fee accounts do not accept ordinary transfers. Check the recipient address.
该账户有一笔结果待核实的操作。核实后才能继续提交，避免重复扣款。: An account operation has an unconfirmed result. Check it before submitting again to avoid duplicate charges.
账户或连接已切换，本次操作已撤销，请重新操作。: The account or connection changed and this operation was cancelled. Start again.
设备登录或资产授权已失效，请重新登录。: Device sign-in or asset authorization expired. Sign in again.
请使用设备管理员账户访问资产功能。: Use a device administrator account to access assets.
暂时无法连接资产服务，请检查网络后刷新。: Cannot connect to the asset service. Check your network and refresh.
金额需为正数，最多 8 位小数，且不能超过支持范围。: Enter a positive amount with at most 8 decimal places, within the supported range.
收款公钥格式或校验和无效，请核对完整地址。: Invalid recipient public key format or checksum. Check the full address.
请检查资产、金额、收款账户和费用设置。: Check the asset, amount, recipient and fee settings.
备份格式或密钥校验不通过，请选择本客户端生成的加密备份。: Backup format or key validation failed. Select an encrypted backup created by this client.
本地加密数据无法验证，请保留原文件并使用备份恢复。: Local encrypted data could not be verified. Preserve the original files and restore a backup.
密钥库文件或目录不符合安全要求。请保留原文件，检查目录是否为链接或改用加密备份恢: The vault file or directory failed safety checks. Preserve the original files, check for symlinks or restore an encrypted backup.
无法读写本地密钥库，请检查磁盘空间和目录权限。: Cannot read or write the local vault. Check disk space and directory permissions.
请将备份保存到密钥库目录以外的位置。: Save the backup outside the vault directory.
密钥库正在由另一个客户端使用，请先关闭另一窗口。: Another client is using the vault. Close the other window first.
本机最多保存 100 个资产账户。: You can save up to 100 asset accounts on this computer.
待核实操作已达到安全上限，请先核实已有操作，再继续提交。: The limit for unconfirmed operations was reached. Check existing results before submitting more.
资产服务拒绝了请求。请检查服务状态后重试。: The asset service rejected the request. Check its status and try again.
操作未完成。请检查连接和密钥库状态后重试。: The operation did not complete. Check the connection and vault, then retry.
已打开本地安全窗口，请核对实际交易内容并确认。: The local security window is open. Review and confirm the transaction details.
备份密码需要 16–128 个字符，最多 512 字节，不能包含控制字符。: Use 16–128 characters (at most 512 bytes) without control characters for the backup password.
备份密码容易被猜到。请改用多个无关词组成的长密码，避免常用词组、重复或连续字符。: This backup password is easy to guess. Use a longer password with unrelated words; avoid common phrases, repetition and sequences.
备份密码不能与密钥库密码相同。请为备份设置独立密码。: Use a backup password that is different from your vault password.
此备份的加密参数不受支持。请保留原文件，使用兼容的桌面版本恢复。: This backup uses unsupported encryption settings. Keep the original file and restore it with a compatible desktop version.
备份未通过读回验证，未标记为完成。请检查磁盘并重新导出。: The saved backup could not be verified and was not marked complete. Check the disk and export again.
系统无法保护密钥内存，资产操作已停止。请检查系统资源或重新启动桌面端。: Protected key memory is unavailable. Asset operations have stopped. Check system resources or restart the desktop app.
系统未能建立所需的私钥进程保护，资产操作已停止。请重启桌面端后重试。: The system could not establish the required private-key process protection. Asset operations have stopped. Restart the desktop app and try again.
密钥进程不可用，资产操作已停止。请重新启动桌面端。: The key process is unavailable. Asset operations have stopped. Restart the desktop app.
密钥操作超时，进程已停止。请重新启动桌面端；如有已提交的交易，请先核实结果。: The key operation timed out and the process was stopped. Restart the desktop app; check the result of any submitted transaction first.
密钥进程通信异常，资产操作已停止。请重新启动桌面端。: Communication with the key process failed. Asset operations have stopped. Restart the desktop app.
请先解锁密钥库，完成账号保护升级。: Unlock the vault to upgrade account protection first.
账号保护升级未通过验证，原文件已保留。请保留备份并重新启动桌面端。: The account protection upgrade could not be verified. The original file was retained. Keep your backups and restart the desktop app.
本次解锁会升级账号保护，账号和地址保持不变。升级后请使用新版桌面端；已有加密备份: Unlocking will upgrade account protection without changing accounts or addresses. Use the new desktop version afterward; existing encrypted backups can still be restored.
建议更新备份：此账号使用旧版备份。请保存一份新版加密备份，原备份仍可恢复。: Backup update recommended: this account uses an older backup. Save a new encrypted backup; the original backup can still be restored.
请使用 16–128 个字符的独立备份密码，例如多个无关词组成的长密码；避免常用: Use a separate 16–128 character backup password, such as a long password of unrelated words. Avoid common patterns, repetition and sequences.
